theme: NQ Globex 6PM ET re-open candle retest stats — Pass 1
sample_size_warning: Sample is only 21 days because TradingView's chart had limited Globex history loaded after recent symbol switches. The 232-day depth available for daytime stats wasn't recovered for overnight bars after switching symbols multiple times. Treat these numbers as PRELIMINARY/DIRECTIONAL only — confidence intervals are roughly ±15pp at this sample size. Re-run on a freshly-loaded chart for production-quality numbers.

preliminary_findings.1: The 6:00 PM open candle is the WEAKEST retest (47.62% by +15, 66.67% by +45). The actual Globex re-open establishes a directional move that holds — much like the 3:00 AM London open and the 9:30 RTH open patterns we documented earlier.
preliminary_findings.2: Sweep rate (both sides) is 0% for the 6:00 PM candle by +45 min. Globex re-opens are highly directional events. By +45 min, only one side has been retested.
preliminary_findings.3: Later Globex candles (6:15-7:15) reach 95-100% retest by +45 — same magnetism pattern as London/Asia.
preliminary_findings.4: 7:15 PM is the strongest Globex magnet (100% retest +45, 42.86% sweep) — possibly because by then the early Globex move has played out and price starts mean-reverting.
preliminary_findings.5: The 6:00 PM candle's 19% low-any rate is the lowest of any session candle ever measured — meaning Globex re-opens almost NEVER take out the open candle's low in the first 45 min. Strong upward bias at re-open.
